connector.name: MCP by clarx.ai
connector.registryDescription: Score agent manifests, generate CI workflows, and pull Clarx scan findings into your IDE.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace ai.clarx. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Enables the BYOK AI tools (suggest_manifest_fix, generate_manifest_draft).

env.name: CLARX_MCP_TOKEN
env.description: Optional. Org-scoped Clarx Cloud API token — unlocks hosted tools (list_repos, get_scan, list_findings, get_remediation_prompt). Create in org settings.
